tier-rewrite-label.pass: It counts as durable intent, ephemeral harness: keep it and flag it for promotion to a boundary test.
tier-rewrite-label.fail: It is just a flaky test; delete it.

tier-verify-drafts.pass: Drafts go in docs/phoenix/proposals/<date>-<slug>/. In a throwaway git worktree it plants mutants with mutate.py; each draft must kill at least one mutant.
tier-verify-drafts.fail: Drop them into src/test and check that coverage rises.

tier-list-tests.fail: Grep the test directory for the class name.
